title: Giraffe

description.en: A personal GitHub observatory for repositories, workflows, and encrypted snapshots.
description.zh: 个人 GitHub 观察台，集中查看仓库、工作流与加密的访问令牌快照。

subject: Honey-colored giraffe portrait nibbling one colorful acacia sprig

source.description: Personal GitHub monitoring console with encrypted PAT snapshots

subject.en: Honey-colored giraffe portrait nibbling one colorful acacia sprig
subject.zh: 轻咬一枝多彩金合欢叶的蜜金色长颈鹿头像

description.en: A broad cheek, natural ear spread and a gently diagonal neck form one portrait. The mouth-held acacia sprig stays close; the lower neck continues through the viewfinder.
description.zh: 宽阔脸颊、自然展开的双耳与倾斜颈部构成统一头像。衔住的金合欢叶靠近嘴边，下方颈部自然延续到取景框外。

description.en: Ochre planes and broad chestnut patches preserve the giraffe’s species cues. One colored leaf sprig replaces the enclosing wreath and competing decorative fragments.
description.zh: 赭黄色面与宽阔栗棕斑纹保留物种特征。一枝多彩叶片取代外圈花环与分散的装饰碎片。

description.en: Staggered flat-topped canopies and open branching stems sit in an olive field. Unequal spans add quiet structure around the ears and leaf gesture.
description.zh: 错落的平顶树冠与开放枝干压在橄榄色底纹上，不同跨度的形状在双耳与叶片周围提供安静的结构。

palette.source: Selected Giraffe presentation, 2026-09-07-01/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: Ossicones, both ears, face and every leaf keep at least 164.64 px of rounded-edge clearance. A one-pixel placement correction preserves the native extraction and closes the lower neck entry. The historical original is 1408 px; the new artwork is native 2048 px.
sizeNote.zh: 角、双耳、面部与每片叶子距圆角边界至少 164.64 px。一次 1 px 位置修正保持抠图原样，并让颈部自然接到底边。历史原图为 1408 px，新图为原生 2048 px。

goal.en: Review repositories, open work, alerts, and daily changes across GitHub accounts in a personal console with on-demand data refreshes.
goal.zh: 在个人控制台查看多个 GitHub 账号的仓库、待办、告警和每日变化，按需同步 GitHub 数据。

role.zh: 应用、Worker 与工具脚本逻辑
Worker HTTP 路由与中间件
GitHub 数据采集与静态托管
账号、加密 PAT 与快照
部署入口与 API 身份认证

role.en: REST and GraphQL repository and notification data
role.zh: REST 与 GraphQL 仓库和通知数据

description.en: Staggered acacia canopies and angled stems echo the small sprig held by the giraffe.
description.zh: 错落的金合欢树冠与倾斜枝干，呼应长颈鹿轻咬的那一枝彩叶。

caption.en: A longer view of your work.

description.en: Honey-colored giraffe portrait nibbling one colorful acacia sprig.
description.zh: 轻咬一枝多彩金合欢叶的蜜金色长颈鹿头像。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥81px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 81px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
